documents.snippet: In Greek mythology, Hyperion is one of the twelve Titans.
documents.content:
Hyperion (mythology)

In Greek mythology, Hyperion is one of the twelve Titans, the children of Gaia and Uranus. He is often described as the father of Helios, Selene, and Eos.

The name has since been used for ships, novels, and a tall coast redwood tree in California.

documents.title: How managed vector databases are priced
documents.snippet: Managed vector database pricing usually depends on storage, query volume, and replicas.
documents.content:
How managed vector databases are priced

Managed vector database pricing usually depends on the amount of data stored, the volume of queries, and the number of replicas.

Some vendors charge per pod or node, while others bill per read and write unit. Self-hosted open-source engines have no license fee but carry infrastructure and operations costs.
